selection_rule: Only an exact, known event ID explicitly followed by (remove) requests removal.
repeated_ids: One marked copy selects the exact event once; unmarked repetitions do not cancel the marker.
variant_scope: The existing ID still represents its full event and supplied wording variants; variant-specific requests need review.
